**Finding: deviation (high) — § 3.4 Termination for Convenience**

- **What works:** Customer has a one-way convenience right on one month's notice (p0044–p0045), and IBM has no convenience right (§ 3.3 is cause-only). IBM must keep performing through the termination date (p0047).
- **What deviates:** the right is gated on "applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments" — an uncapped, externally defined penalty — and the Agreement contains no refund of prepaid Charges (no "refund" language anywhere; § 3.5 only accelerates Customer payments).
- **Redline (validated, preferred):** replaces § 3.4(b) with a no-penalty statement plus a 30-day pro-rata refund of prepaid Charges; fallback offered is a fee capped at three months' Charges.
